title: Walecki's decomposition of $K_{2n+1}$ into connected 2-factors
statement: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the complete graph $K_{2n+1}$ on $2n+1$ vertices can be expressed as the edge-disjoint union of $n$ connected $2$-factors. Concretely, there exist spanning subgraphs $H_1, \ldots, H_n$ of $K_{2n+1}$, each of which is $2$-regular (every vertex has exactly two neighbours in it) and connected, whose edge sets are pairwise disjoint and whose union is all of $K_{2n+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: ambient graph is the complete graph on 2n+1 vertices
each H_i is a spanning subgraph
the union of the H_i is the whole complete graph
